2607.28196.title: Fidelity Is Not Safety: Gently-Compressed LLMs Pass Every Data-Free Quality Guard Yet Invent Procedure Steps in Agentic Execution
2607.28196.paper_summary: Practitioners accept a compressed language model once it clears a stack of data-cheap quality guards: perplexity within a small factor of the original, downstream accuracy (for example MMLU) inside a confidence interval, and data-free output-fidelity signals that compare the compressed and original network's internal representations under random probe inputs. This stack has a blind spot. Across three model families, gently-compressed models clear every guard and then invent procedure steps that were never in the instructions when they run a standard operating procedure (SOP) as an agent. The effect is operator-specific: coherent low-rank (SVD) truncation induces it, and magnitude pruning matched to the same perplexity does not. One dissociation isolates the cause. The same compressed weights that CI-win a paired output-fidelity test CI-fail the invented-step canary. The governing axis is the coherence of the compression error times its rate; the magnitude of the damage does not predict it. The data-free fidelity probe is a fidelity oracle by construction, so it cannot see this axis. We characterize the blindspot and dissociation with paired confidence intervals on a pre-registered, powered canary across three architectures. Operator-specificity replicates on all three, and the perplexity-guard evasion appears where the model admits in-guard low-rank headroom. We then give a data-free screen: a two-axis statistic of the compression error (coherent-fraction and error-rate) that flags the failing builds with fixed thresholds across architectures and matches the coherence-times-rate mechanism. Perplexity, MMLU, and fidelity acceptance do not certify agent safety. Screen gently-compressed low-rank builds before agentic deployment
2607.28196.paper_summary_zh: 從業者在壓縮語言模型通過一系列數據便宜的質量檢查後接受它：困惑度在原始值的小範圍內、下游準確性（例如 MMLU）在置信區間內，以及無數據的輸出保真信號，這些信號比較壓縮和原始網絡在隨機探針輸入下的內部表示。這一系列檢查存在盲點。在三個模型家族中，輕微壓縮的模型通過每一個檢查，然後在作為代理執行標準操作程序（SOP）時發明從未在指令中的步驟。這一效應是特定於操作員的：一致的低秩（SVD）截斷會引發它，而與相同困惑度匹配的幅度修剪則不會。一個解離現象隔離了原因。相同的壓縮權重在成對的輸出保真測試中獲勝，但在發明步驟的金絲雀測試中失敗。主導軸是壓縮誤差的一致性乘以其速率；損害的大小並不能預測它。無數據的保真探測器本質上是一個保真神諭，因此無法看到這一軸。我們通過在三個架構上進行預註冊的、具備能力的金絲雀的成對置信區間來描述盲點和解離。操作員特異性在所有三個架構上都能複製，而困惑度檢查逃避出現在模型承認在檢查內部的低秩空間時。我們隨後提供一個無數據的篩檢：一個關於壓縮誤差的雙軸統計（一致性比例和錯誤率），它在不同架構中以固定閾值標記失敗的構建，並符合一致性乘以速率的機制。困惑度、MMLU 和保真接受並不能證明代理的安全性。在代理部署之前，先篩檢輕微壓縮的低秩構建。
2607.28196.author: I. Kennedy et.al.
